scope: Normalized current-behavior contracts, deterministic 465-seed mapping, and compact persona/tier/time/outcome/failure axes.

provenance.contract_source: Repository code and behavioral tests at the Assignment base SHA.
provenance.normalization_note: The tracked file is the reviewable source. Cartesian scenario expansion is generated only by tests or later evidence runners.

contract_field_policy.not_applicable: Allowed only as an object with status=NOT_APPLICABLE and a non-empty reason.
contract_field_policy.evidence_rule: Every seed inherits its own non-meta test_refs from the surface inventory and the mapped contract's behavioral references.

behavior_contracts.scope: OTP, login, session approval/recovery/revocation, registration authentication, logout and expiry.

rules: Account state and invitation/session authority are evaluated before credential or session mutation.
OTP/session operations use their persisted request, quota and generation state.
Validated OTP/login/session command plus authenticated actor or invitation context.
Surface and provider choice remain explicit inputs.
Return the current endpoint or Bot result without disclosing whether a protected login request exists.
Terminal success is returned only after authoritative state is durable.
Mutate users, login requests or user_sessions only in the owning command transaction.
Expiry and revocation preserve session-generation ordering.
Delivery intent or synchronized identity mutation is durable before asynchronous execution when the current path uses an outbox/receipt.
SMS or Telegram delivery occurs only through the configured owner and never from a tokenless API process.
Validate authority and quota, persist request/session state, then deliver or acknowledge.
Revocation precedes acceptance of a replacement session generation.
Expired OTP/login/session requests fail closed.
Provider-ambiguous OTP delivery is not blindly resent with the same code.
Login/session request identity and delivery receipt prevent duplicate terminalization.
Unknown, inactive or deleted account is denied.
Missing authority, stale generation or expired request causes no successful session.

behavior_contracts.scope: Invitation, user/relation/accountant management, Telegram linking, block/flag and account-state projection.

rules: Actor role and owner/accountant/customer relation are resolved from authoritative rows.
Telegram eligibility uses active account, relation and tier projection.
Validated invitation, relation, user-management or linking command with stable entity identity.
Visibility and denial copy follow actor/relation policy.
Unknown or stale projection does not grant access.
Identity, invitation and relation transitions are committed atomically with their audit-relevant state.
Account-state changes revoke affected local sessions where current behavior requires it.
Shared identity changes enter the durable change path; local Telegram registration intent stays local until authoritative acceptance.
Only eligible linked Telegram accounts receive Bot access or identity notification.
Accountant and tier-2 Bot denials remain explicit.
Validate invitation/relation and current account state before link or access grant.
Authoritative mutation becomes visible before reconciliation finalizes local intent.
Expired invitation/link intent is rejected.
Reconciliation retries without creating a foreign authoritative User.
Invitation/link identity and intent receipt prevent duplicate relation or account creation.
Accountant and tier-2 customer cannot gain Bot market access.
Unknown relation, duplicate identity or stale intent fails closed.

behavior_contracts.scope: Create, parse, list, repeat, expire, cancel, republish and Telegram publication of Offers.

rules: Authenticated non-accountant actor; accountant context is rejected by _ensure_accountant_market_access_allowed.
Tier-2 customer cannot own Offers; get_my_repeatable_offers returns [] for tier-2.
Market admission, home authority and price guard must pass before commit.
Offer payload or parsed Bot text includes commodity, side, quantity, price, settlement and explicit origin surface.
Overtime preference is snapshotted at creation.
Success returns the durable Offer projection.
Market-closed or authority rejection is explicit and does not claim creation.
Offer and idempotency/publication state change in the authoritative transaction.
created_at and overtime_minutes_snapshot are immutable after create; expiry/cancel/republish use legal transitions.

Current durable origin is still offers.home_server: WEBAPP maps to historical iran and TELEGRAM_BOT maps to historical foreign. Immutable offer_origin_surface is an approved DR-004 gap, not a live column.
Committed Offer mutation emits the durable change/event intent before asynchronous publication or peer delivery.
Realtime/cache and Telegram publication occur only for eligible committed state and are receipt/idempotency guarded.
Resolve actor and policy, final market admission, commit Offer/outbox, then publish/notify.
Terminal transition precedes terminal presentation update.
Repeat/expiry use immutable created_at and the snapshotted overtime deadline.
Idempotent replay of the same key returns the existing Offer without a second publication.
Market-close at final admission rejects with no Offer row and no side effect.
Final quota rejection maps to a deterministic error with no side effect.
Offer creation command key and publication state prevent duplicate Offer and Telegram post.
Accountant, watch-role, temporarily restricted, closed market, invalid price, wrong home or stale state is rejected.
Same idempotency key with a different payload conflicts; it does not create a second Offer.
Publication/cache/SSE failure after commit keeps the Offer and is retryable without changing provenance.

behavior_contracts.scope: Normal and overtime requests against Offers, owner decision, cancellation and forwarding.

rules: Offer is active and request actor is eligible on the chosen surface.
Overtime request additionally requires a positive Offer snapshot and receipt inside the final deadline.
Offer identity, requester, action surface, source server, policy/tier snapshots and idempotency key.
Accepted, queued, presented, rejected, cancelled or replayed status is deterministic.
Requester never receives false terminal failure after durable acceptance.
OfferRequest ledger transition and snapshots are committed atomically.
Terminal request state is immutable.
Owner-approval or requester-status delivery intent is durable before provider execution.
Web or Telegram owner/requester notification respects immutable source surface and audience privacy.
Validate Offer and actor, reserve/create ledger, commit, then deliver approval/status.
Owner decision precedes Trade execution.
Overtime freshness and delivery deadlines are snapshotted.
Retry resumes nonterminal state; expired decisions become a defined terminal status.
Request command key returns the prior ledger result and prevents duplicate owner prompts.
Expired/ineligible Offer, denied actor, stale owner decision or mismatched receipt is rejected.
Forward success without matching durable receipt fails closed.

behavior_contracts.scope: Trade wizard, execution, inventory/commission/settlement, history/export and delivery.

rules: Offer/request is authoritative and eligible; actor context and quantity are current.
Customer limit, inventory and legal transition checks pass.
Offer/request identity, actor, quantity/lot/price/settlement, source surface and policy/relation snapshots.
One authoritative Trade result or deterministic conflict/rejection is returned.
History/export visibility follows participant and relation privacy.
Trade, Offer fill/state, request ledger and delivery receipts commit with inventory and settlement invariants.
Tier-2 commission affects the correct execution leg only and uses the request-time snapshot.

Current Trade rows do not store a complete immutable provenance snapshot of Offer origin, Request origin, execution surface, policy version and actor/tier; that is the approved DR-004 implementation gap.
Trade delivery and sync intents are durable with the business transaction or recoverably linked receipt.
Web realtime/Web Push and Telegram trade delivery are audience-aware and deduplicated.
Lock/revalidate Offer and limits, commit business facts/receipts, then deliver.
Wizard back/cancel changes FSM presentation only when its state is current.
Stale Offer/request/FSM state is rejected.
Delivery retries do not apply the Trade or notify twice.
Request/Trade receipt and contention guard select one winner for retries and concurrent commands.
Oversell, negative inventory, limit breach, stale wizard, wrong authority or invalid transition fails closed.
Post-commit delivery failure leaves a repairable receipt.

behavior_contracts.scope: Market schedule, fact/snapshot visibility, estimator state, notices and Offer price guard.

rules: Schedule and Market facts satisfy source, timestamp, schema, unit and quality policy.
No synthetic value may satisfy a business/scientific gate.
Versioned schedule/fact/snapshot with event, availability and local-insert time bounds.
Published estimate/guard result exposes freshness/confidence or explicit no-data/degraded state.
Market runtime state, canonical facts/projections and notice receipts use their owning transaction and immutable fact identity.
Eligible committed Market transition/fact emits a durable projection or delivery intent.
Realtime Market state, price guard and Telegram notice use committed eligible data and one delivery owner.
Capture and validate before projection/model publication.
Schedule commit precedes offer-expiry and notice side effects.
Stale inputs widen confidence/range according to approved policy rather than silently becoming fresh.
Retries preserve point-in-time bounds.
Stable fact/event and notice receipt identity prevent duplicate projection and channel notice.
Unknown unit/schema/source/hash, gap or invalid magnitude is rejected/quarantined.
Missing data remains explicit and cannot be replaced by fabricated evidence.

behavior_contracts.scope: Messenger rooms, messages, edits/deletes/reactions, media/upload, unread/seen and realtime.

rules: Authenticated actor is a permitted room member and relation/privacy checks pass.
Referenced media/upload session is owned, complete and current.
Stable room/message/media identity plus command revision and actor context.
Return the authoritative message/room revision and deterministic unread/seen state.
Unauthorized membership is not disclosed.
Message/revision/membership/read state and media reference update atomically for each command.
Incomplete upload remains local transient state.
Committed final Messenger state emits realtime/sync intent with stable IDs and revision ordering.
WebSocket/SSE/Web Push audience matches room membership and does not duplicate committed messages.
Authorize and validate revision before mutation; commit before realtime/push.
Revision order, unread and seen markers are monotonic.
Expired upload session is rejected and cleaned by retention.
Reconnect/retry resumes from stable revision without adjacent-media inference.
Stable message/public ID and revision prevent duplicate send/edit/delete application.
Missing membership, stale revision, incomplete upload or referenced blob mismatch fails closed/quarantines sync.

behavior_contracts.scope: Notification create/read/delete/preferences/subscription, stream and test Web Push.

rules: Authenticated actor owns the notification/preferences/subscription or has explicit admin test authority.
Web Push configuration is validated before send.
Notification/audience identity, read/delete/preference command or validated Push payload.
Unread count and row state reflect the committed command.
Unconfigured test Push returns 503 and sends nothing.
Notification/read/delete/preference/subscription state commits once for the owning user.
Durable notification row/outbox intent precedes asynchronous local Push or Telegram delivery.
Realtime/Web Push/Telegram notification targets only the resolved audience and is receipt guarded.
Authorize and persist audience state before stream/push delivery.
Preference/subscription state is read before selecting a provider.
Provider failure remains retryable or terminal per receipt without duplicating the notification row.
Notification/outbox/provider receipt identity prevents duplicate delivery.
Wrong owner, missing configuration, invalid subscription or stale notification is rejected with no unintended send.

behavior_contracts.scope: Bot messages/callbacks/FSM anchors, publisher dispatch and Telegram provider execution.

rules: User/Bot access and callback/FSM freshness pass.
Exactly one credentialed Telegram executor owns the enabled lane.
Telegram update/callback or durable delivery job with identity, lane, payload hash and receipt context.
Callback is acknowledged once and message/FSM state reflects the authoritative command.
Denied/stale action gets deterministic copy.
FSM/anchor/queue/provider receipt changes use legal transitions and atomic claim/ACK.
API/domain producers persist Telegram intent; the executor consumes without becoming business authority.
Only the Telegram executor sends/edits/answers through Bot API and records a nonsecret provider outcome.
Validate freshness/authority, persist or claim receipt, execute provider call, then ACK/finalize.
Business commit is never inferred from provider success.
Transient safe failures retry with bounded backoff.
Provider-ambiguous send enters reconciliation instead of blind replay.
Delivery job/receipt/payload identity and callback freshness prevent duplicate provider side effect.
Second owner, stale callback/FSM, invalid lane/permission or ambiguous outcome fails closed/reconciles.

behavior_contracts.scope: Admin user/commodity/settings management, broadcasts and market/operator messages.

rules: Current actor has the route/command-specific admin role.
Target entity and requested transition are current and valid.
Validated admin command including actor, target, before/after intent and idempotency context where available.
Unauthorized actor is denied without mutation.
Success returns the committed entity/setting/broadcast state.
Admin-managed entity, audit-relevant state and delivery receipts commit according to the command transaction.
Shared admin mutations and broadcast delivery intents use durable change/outbox paths.
Cache invalidation, notifications and broadcasts happen only for committed authorized commands and resolved audience.
Authorize, validate target/transition, commit/audit, then invalidate cache or deliver.
Broadcast group selection is stored before confirmation/send.
Retry reuses command/broadcast receipt and does not fan out twice.
Stale target/confirmation is rejected.
Admin command or broadcast receipt identifies the authoritative result and recipient fanout.
Non-admin, invalid target/group/value, stale state or duplicate confirmation is denied/no-op deterministically.

behavior_contracts.scope: Committed change emission, delivery, signature/version validation, apply, gap/conflict and repair.

rules: Table/version/field policy, source authority, sequence/hash/signature and peer identity are known.
Sensitive/local-only fields are excluded.
Stable event identity, source/site, sequence, schema version, payload hash/signature and allowlisted mutation.
Return applied, duplicate, retryable, rejected or quarantined with visible reason.
Unknown authority/schema/hash never returns applied.
Business apply and checkpoint/dedupe update are atomic.
Duplicate delivery changes no business state.
Local authoritative commit appends immutable outbound change; ACK only follows peer durable acceptance.
Peer transport/retry queue and operator health evidence reflect gaps/rejections without deleting history.
Verify envelope and sequence before business apply, commit apply/checkpoint atomically, then ACK.
Gap repair is forward-only.
Unavailable peer keeps local change pending with bounded retry.
Duplicate event replays acknowledgement without reapplication.
Stable event ID plus source sequence/hash is the dedupe and ordering identity.
Unknown table/version/authority, forbidden field, signature/hash mismatch, gap or invariant violation fails closed/quarantines.

behavior_contracts.scope: Live OPS seeds only: public config, metrics, frontend serve, home/account/settings shell, catch-all system-recovery, and connectivity_monitor. Deploy/restart/backup/restore duration is not one of these seeds; it is DR-015.

rules: Public config and metrics handlers expose non-secret runtime facts already available to the process.
Frontend/home/account/settings/system-recovery routes render or recover the shell without claiming backend readiness.
connectivity_monitor is an observational job authorized on historical iran and writes only redis:connectivity:global.
HTTP GET for /api/config, /metrics, /, /{full_path:path}, or the matching frontend routes; or the scheduled connectivity probe.
Health/config/metrics report UNKNOWN/STALE/FAILED honestly and never paint missing evidence green.
Frontend shell recovery does not imply API or Bot readiness.

db_mutations.reason: The ten live OPS seeds do not mutate product tables. connectivity_monitor.mutated_tables is empty; backup/restore mutations are not present in this inventory and stay under DR-015/DPL-1.

events_outbox.reason: Live OPS seeds emit no product outbox/event row; operator connectivity evidence is local Redis observation.

rules: connectivity_monitor may refresh redis:connectivity:global and must not change Web Writer, DNS or Telegram ownership.
Frontend static serve and shell recovery have no production deploy/restart/backup side effect.
Readiness/config/metrics observation is independent of Bot restart and of Web Writer state.
Shared PostgreSQL/Redis failure must be exposed, not masked as healthy.
Probe timeout becomes unknown/stale, not inferred healthy or automatic failover.
Measured deploy/restart/backup/restore durations are NOT_OBSERVED and are not estimated here.

idempotency_key.reason: Read-only config/metrics/frontend and observational connectivity have no product command identity; later DPL-1 operation journals own deploy/restore idempotency.

rules: Unknown release/schema/config/owner or failed readiness blocks activation claims.
No lease, timer or connectivity signal changes Web Writer.

behavior_contracts.scope: Offer origin, Request/action origin, actor/persona, tier and time-context policy composition.

rules: Offer origin is a product surface, not a physical host. Today it is inferred from home_server (WEBAPP→iran, TELEGRAM_BOT→foreign) until DR-004 lands.
Request actor and action surface are independently authenticated and policy-evaluated.
evaluate_bot_access_projection denies accountant and customer_tier=tier2 before any Bot market command.
offer_origin, request_origin, actor persona/tier/account_status, telegram link presence, time context, policy version and home authority.
Eligibility is the composed persona × surface × time decision, not a host/DNS/process value.
Denied Bot access returns the current reason copy: accountant, customer_tier2, inactive, deleted, role_forbidden, customer_unavailable or pending_sync.
Offer/Request/Trade keep independent origin/action and policy snapshots through legal business transitions.
The same provenance fields travel in outbox/sync/audit/parity representations.
Web, Web Push and Telegram audience/publication follow the resolved action surface without rewriting Offer origin.
Resolve actor/tier/surface/time policy before mutation; persist snapshots before delivery.
Normal/overtime/closed decisions use immutable created_at and snapshot deadlines.
Retry/concurrency use the same policy snapshot.
Offer/Request/Trade command identities preserve one result across surface retry and concurrency.
Accountant market mutation is denied on Web and Bot.
Tier-2 cannot own Offers or use Bot; Web request-only remains allowed when other gates pass.
Unlinked Telegram identity cannot execute Bot market commands.
Closed market or terminal Offer rejects new mutation; INTERNAL origin cannot impersonate WEBAPP or TELEGRAM_BOT actors.

behavior_contracts.scope: Atomicity, durable intent, provider ambiguity, concurrency, restart recovery and unknown-authority failure envelopes.

rules: The same domain command is observed at a named failure boundary with stable identity and frozen clock/policy where relevant.
One valid command plus one explicit injected boundary; production data or side effects are not used in P1-00.
Result is committed/retryable/replayed/conflict/rejected according to the named boundary and never false-success.
Pre-commit failure leaves no business mutation; post-commit failure preserves committed state and recoverable receipt.
Atomic business/outbox boundary prevents an unrepairable committed fact without delivery intent.
Provider side effect before ACK is reconciled/deduplicated and never blindly repeated.
Commit precedes external side effect; provider evidence precedes ACK; sequence/authority validation precedes apply.
Retry resumes durable state with bounded policy; restart cannot invent ownership or promotion.
Stable command/event/receipt identity selects one authoritative result under retry and concurrency.
Unknown authority/schema/hash, gap, duplicate, second owner or ambiguous provider outcome is visible and fail-closed.
